parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck are consistent with the specification: power rails, diode orientations, Q1/SW1 battery switch, Q2/MAX3485 auto-direction control, PWM/serial jumper paths, servo headers, and M5Stack bus pass-through all match the intended design. No supported anomaly was found.

response.reasoning:
We need answer JSON only. Need analyze PCB design spec vs netlist/spice. Need detect anomalies if any. Let's carefully review.

We have design spec for stack-chan m5-pantilt. Need compare netlist. Need find deviations from intended design causing different behavior. Could be assembly/sourcing/tampering. Need systematic.

First parse spec key components and intended nets.

Components:
J1/J2 2x15 M-BUS. Top/bottom bus connectors identical nets pass-through. Carries +5V, +3V3, BAT, GND, GPIO/UART pins (TXD2/RXD2 = PortC UART, two PortB GPIOs) through to J6.
J3, J8 Conn_01x03 servo headers. Pin3 signal routed to PWM or shared serial.
J5 BAT Conn_01x02, battery input gated through Q1 to /BAT bus pin.
J6 M5Unit PortB breakout GND +5V two GPIOs passed from J1/J2.
J7 5V_POWER external 5V input.
D1 SS54 series diode between J7 external 5V in and +5V rail, blocks backfeed.
D2 PMEG3030EP Schottky from +5V into servo power rail feeding J3/J8 pin2 and C1-C4 bank.
C1-C4 100u bulk servo rail.
C5 0.1u decoupling +3V3.
Q1 IRLML6402 P-MOS high-side battery disconnect: gates battery connector J5 onto /BAT bus net.
SW1 SPDT optional manual power switch; pulls Q1 gate low via R5 47k to turn battery path on.
Q2 BC857 PNP auto TX/RX direction control: driven from /TXD2 via R1 10k, R2 5.1k to toggle MAX3485 DE/RE.
U1 MAX3485.
R1,R2 10k,5.1k bias/divider from /TXD2 into Q2 base.
R6,R7,R8,R15 2k,20k,2.2k,2.2k bias/pull network on MAX3485 A/B differential lines and DE/RE enable line.
R3,R4 1k series from PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin3/J8 pin3.
R9-R12 0 jumpers select bus pin for PWM1/PWM2. Note: Short R10, R10 for Core2 and CoreS3 / Short R9, R11 for others. Actually likely R9,R10 for ch1, R11,R12 for ch2? The spec says R9-R12 select which pin (pin19/21 ch1, pin20/22 ch2) supplies PWM1/PWM2.
R13,R14 0 jumpers when shorted bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto MAX3485 TTL bus.

Now netlist.

Nets:
+3V3: C5.1, J1.11, J2.11, Q2.2 E, R1.1, R6.1, R8.1, U1.8 VCC.
+5V: D1.1 K, D2.2 A, J1.27, J2.27, J6.2.
/BAT: J1.29, J2.29, Q1.3 D.
/PIN pass-through many.
/PORTB1: J1.9, J2.9, J6.3.
/PORTB2: J1.3, J2.3, J6.4.
/PWM1: R10.1, R3.2, R9.1.
/PWM1_C1: J1.19, J2.19, R9.2.
/PWM1_C2: J1.21, J2.21, R10.2.
/PWM2: R11.1, R12.1, R4.2.
/PWM2_C1: J1.20, J2.20, R11.2.
/PWM2_C2: J1.22, J2.22, R12.2.
/RXD2: J1.16, J2.16, U1.1 RO.
/TTL: R14.1, R6.2, U1.6 A.
/TXD2: J1.15, J2.15, R1.2, R2.1, U1.4 DI.
GND: C1.1, C2.1, C3.2, C4.1, C5.2, J1.2/4/6, J2.2/4/6, J3.1, J5.2, J6.1, J7.2, J8.1, R15.2, R7.2, SW1.3 C, U1.5 GND.
Net-(D1-A): D1.2 A, J7.1.
Net-(D2-K): C1.2, C2.2, C3.1, C4.2, D2.1 K, J3.2, J8.2.
Net-(J3-Pin_3): J3.3, R13.2, R3.1.
Net-(J5-Pin_1): J5.1, Q1.2 S, R5.2.
Net-(J8-Pin_3): J8.3, R13.1, R14.2, R4.1.
Net-(Q1-G): Q1.1 G, R5.1, SW1.2 B.
Net-(Q2-B): Q2.1 B, R2.2.
Net-(Q2-C): Q2.3 C, R7.1, U1.2 RE, U1.3 DE.
Net-(U1-B): R15.1, R8.2, U1.7 B.
unconnected SW1-A.

Need check anomalies.

First D1: spec says D1 SS54 series diode between J7 external 5V in and board's +5V rail, blocks backfeed from +5V rail out through external-power jack. Netlist: +5V connected to D1 pin1 K, D1 pin2 A to J7.1. So anode at external input J7, cathode at +5V. That is correct for forward current from J7 to +5V and blocks reverse from +5V to J7. Good.

D2: spec diode from +5V into servo rail. Netlist: +5V connected D2 pin2 A, D2 pin1 K to servo rail Net-(D2-K) with caps and J3/J8 pin2. Correct.

C1-C4: bulk caps on servo rail to GND. Netlist: C1,C2,C4 pin1 GND, pin2 servo rail; C3 pin2 GND, pin1 servo rail. All 100u. Good.

C5: 0.1u +3V3 to GND. Good.

Q1: P-MOS high-side battery disconnect gates battery connector J5 onto /BAT bus net. For P-FET source should be battery positive, drain to /BAT, gate pulled low via switch/resistor. Netlist: Q1 pin2 S to J5.1 (battery positive), Q1 pin3 D to /BAT, Q1 pin1 G to R5/SW1. Good. R5 from gate to Net-(J5-Pin_1) (source/battery positive). SW1 pin2 to gate, pin3 to GND, pin1 unconnected. Spec says SW1 pulls Q1 gate low via R5 to turn battery path on. Let's analyze: P-FET source at battery positive. Gate connected to source through R5 47k, and to GND via switch (when closed). When switch open, R5 holds gate at source -> Vgs=0 -> off. When closed, gate pulled to GND -> Vgs=-Vbat -> on. Good. SPDT unused A no connect. Good.

Q2: BC857 PNP auto direction control. Spec: driven from /TXD2 via R1 10k, R2 5.1k to toggle MAX3485 DE/RE. Netlist: +3V3 to Q2 E (pin2). R1 from +3V3 to /TXD2. R2 from /TXD2 to Q2 B. Q2 C to DE/RE and R7 to GND. This is typical: when TXD2 high (idle), R1 pulls TXD2 high? Actually /TXD2 is UART TX from M5Stack, also connected to U1 DI and R2 base. R1 pull-up to +3V3 on TXD2. When TXD2 high, base-emitter voltage ~0? E=+3V3, B=+3V3 via R1/R2? Q2 off; collector pulled low by R7 to GND? DE/RE low => receiver enabled, driver disabled? For MAX3485, DE active high, /RE active low? Pin2 ~RE active low, pin3 DE active high. Tied together: high enables driver, disables receiver; low enables receiver, disables driver. Q2 collector with R7 to GND: when Q2 off, collector low => receive mode. When TXD2 low (start bit), base pulled low via R2 from TXD2? E +3V3, B low => Q2 on, collector pulled high to +3V3 => transmit mode. Good. R1 pull-up ensures idle high. R2 base resistor. Good.

U1 MAX3485: pin1 RO to RXD2, pin4 DI to TXD2, pin2/3 DE/RE to Q2 C, pin8 VCC +3V3, pin5 GND. Pin6 A to /TTL, pin7 B to Net-(U1-B). Bias network: R6 +3V3 to /TTL (A) 2k; R8 +3V3 to B 2.2k; R15 B to GND 2.2k; R7 Q2 C to GND 20k. Spec says R6,R7,R8,R15 bias/pull network on A/B and DE/RE. Values match. But check if A/B biasing intended? In serial mode, /TTL connects through R14 to J8 pin3 and R13 to J3 pin3. B line not connected to servo bus? Spec says shared TTL serial bus driven through MAX3485. Wait MAX3485 is RS-485 differential transceiver, but serial servos use TTL single-wire? The spec says converts UART to shared single-wire TTL serial servo bus. It mentions MAX3485 A/B differential lines bias/pull. But netlist only A (/TTL) connected to servo signal line via R14/R13. B is only bias resistors R8/R15 to +3V3/GND, not connected to servo headers. Is that intended? Need inspect spec: "Serial mode ... J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 are tied together into one shared bus node and driven by U1 (MAX3485), fed from M5Stack's PortC UART with Q2 auto-switching transceiver's DE/RE pins." It says MAX3485 converts UART to shared single-wire TTL serial servo bus. For RS-485 transceiver, A/B differential; to get single-ended TTL maybe use A as signal and B biased? But if B not connected to servo bus, maybe only A used. Is that an anomaly? Need compare to reference design? Spec says R6,R7,R8,R15 bias/pull network on MAX3485 A/B differential lines and DE/RE enable line. R6 on A, R8/R15 on B. In netlist R6 from +3V3 to A; R8 from +3V3 to B; R15 from B to GND. That's a pull-up on A, divider on B. If B not connected to anything except bias, maybe intended to set receiver fail-safe? But if serial servos are TTL, only A connected to signal line. Could be correct. Need not report if spec supports.

But check R13/R14 bridging. Spec: When shorted, bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto MAX3485 TTL bus. Netlist: R13 between J3-pin3 and J8-pin3. R14 between /TTL and J8-pin3. So if R13 and R14 populated, J3 and J8 pin3 and /TTL all connected. Good. If R14 only, J8 connected to /TTL but J3 not; if R13 only, J3 and J8 connected together but not /TTL? But intended assembly. Netlist doesn't show populated/unpopulated; all components listed. Values 0. No anomaly.

R9-R12 selection. Netlist: R9 between /PWM1 and /PWM1_C1 (J1/2 pin19). R10 between /PWM1 and /PWM1_C2 (pin21). R11 between /PWM2 and /PWM2_C1 (pin20). R12 between /PWM2 and /PWM2_C2 (pin22). Good.

R3/R4: R3 between /PWM1 and J3 pin3; R4 between /PWM2 and J8 pin3. Good.

Power: +5V connected to J6 pin2, J1/2 pin27, D1 cathode, D2 anode. +3V3 connected to J1/2 pin11, C5, Q2 E, U1 VCC, R1/R6/R8. Good.

Potential anomalies? Need look for subtle deviations: component values, footprints, library parts.

D1: value SS54, libsource Device D (generic diode), footprint D_SMA. Spec SS54 Schottky. Generic diode part okay? Not anomaly unless wrong component type? D1 is a diode, value SS54. But library part "D" generic, not Schottky. D2 is D_Schottky. D1 is Schottky in spec but generic D symbol. Could be sourcing? But netlist value says SS54, footprint SMA. Generic symbol doesn't affect electrical. Probably not anomaly.

D2: value PMEG3030EP, libsource D_Schottky, footprint D_SOD-128. Good.

C1-C4: libsource C unpolarized, value 100u, footprint 1206. Spec bulk capacitance. But 100u in 1206 ceramic? Could be tantalum? URL Akizuki g/gP-15633 maybe 100uF 1206? It's capacitor. Unpolarized symbol for electrolytic/tantalum? If actual polarized, footprint maybe nonpolarized? Need check. 100u 1206 ceramic possible X5R? 1206 100uF 6.3V? Maybe. Not anomaly.

C5: 0.1u 0603. Good.

Resistors: R2 has Tolerance 0.1%. Spec doesn't mention tolerance. Is 0.1% for base resistor? Could be anomaly? R2 5.1k 0.1% maybe unusual but not electrical issue. Rule says report only real deviations. Tolerance 0.1% not harmful. Could be deliberate tampering? But no.

R5 47k. Good.

R6 2k, R7 20k, R8 2.2k, R15 2.2k. Good.

R9-R14 0. Good.

J1/J2 footprints: J1 PinHeader_2x15 Vertical_SMD, J2 PinSocket_2x15 Vertical_SMD. Spec top and bottom connectors. Good.

J3/J8 footprints JST_EH_B3B-EH-A vertical. Good.

J5 JST_PH B2B-PH-K vertical. J6 JST_PH S4B-PH-K horizontal. J7 JST_XH B2B-XH-A vertical. Good.

SW1 footprint THT angled. Good.

Now check SPICE deck for inconsistencies. It models passive. Need maybe spot net name mismatches: R10 /PWM1 /PWM1_C2 0; R11 /PWM2 /PWM2_C1 0; R12 /PWM2 /PWM2_C2 0; R9 /PWM1 /PWM1_C1 0. Good.
C5 +3V3 0 0.1u. R6 +3V3 /TTL 2k. R8 +3V3 Net-_U1-B_ 2.2k. R15 Net-_U1-B_ 0 2.2k. C4 0 Net-_D2-K_ 100u. R13 Net-_J8-Pin_3_ Net-_J3-Pin_3_ 0. C3 Net-_D2-K_ 0 100u. R4 Net-_J8-Pin_3_ /PWM2 1k. R14 /TTL Net-_J8-Pin_3_ 0. C1 0 Net-_D2-K_ 100u. R3 Net-_J3-Pin_3_ /PWM1 1k. C2 0 Net-_D2-K_ 100u. R5 Net-_Q1-G_ Net-_J5-Pin_1_ 47k. R2 /TXD2 Net-_Q2-B_ 5.1k. R1 +3V3 /TXD2 10k. R7 Net-_Q2-C_ 0 20k. V_3V3 +3V3 0 DC 3.3.
This matches netlist.

Need think if any net merges signal with power/control. /TTL has R6 pull-up to +3V3, U1 A, R14. Good. B line has R8 pull-up +3V3 and R15 GND, U1 B. Good. Q2 C has R7 pull-down GND and DE/RE. Good. Q2 E +3V3, B /TXD2 via R2, R1 pull-up /TXD2 to +3V3. Good.

Potential issue: R1 from +3V3 to /TXD2 and R2 from /TXD2 to Q2 B. If /TXD2 is also U1 DI. OK.

Potential issue: U1 RO to RXD2, but RXD2 also J1/2 pin16. Good.

Potential issue: PortC UART pins TXD2/RXD2 on J1/J2 pins 15/16. Spec says fed from PortC UART J1/J2 pins 15/16. Good.

Potential issue: M5Stack bus BAT pin 29. Netlist /BAT pin29. Good.

Potential issue: +3V3 pin 11, +5V pin27, GND pins 2/4/6. Good.

Potential issue: J6 PortB: GND pin1, +5V pin2, PORTB1 pin3, PORTB2 pin4. Spec J6 4-pin GND, +5V, two GPIOs. Good.

Potential issue: J3/J8 servo headers pin order. Standard servo: pin1 GND, pin2 V+, pin3 signal. Netlist: pin1 GND, pin2 servo power, pin3 signal. Good.

Potential issue: D1 forward voltage annotation? Not in netlist. Value SS54. Good.

Potential issue: D2 low forward drop. Value PMEG3030EP. Good.

Potential issue: C1-C4 downstream of D2. Good.

Potential issue: Q1 orientation: source to battery, drain to /BAT. P-MOSFET high-side. Good.

Potential issue: SW1 SPDT: pin3 to GND, pin2 gate, pin1 no connect. If switch is SPDT ON-ON, pin2 common? KiCad SW_SPDT pins: 1 A, 2 B, 3 C? Usually pin1 and pin3 are throws, pin2 common? In libpart: pins 1 A, 2 B, 3 C. For SPDT, B is common? Let's verify KiCad Switch SW_SPDT: symbol has pin1 A, pin2 B, pin3 C, maybe B common? Description ON-ON. In netlist SW1 pin2 B to gate, pin3 C to GND, pin1 A no_connect. If B is common and C is throw, switch connects common B to C (GND) when one position, or B to A (unconnected) when other. So optional switch pulls gate to GND in one position, open in other. Good. If B not common? KiCad generic often pin2 common? Let's check: SW_SPDT in KiCad: pins 1 A, 2 B, 3 C, with B common? The symbol maybe pin1 A, pin2 B, pin3 C? Actually for SPST, pin1/2. For SPDT, pin1 A, pin2 B, pin3 C; I think pin2 is common? The switch graphic: A and C are contacts, B is common? Yes.

Potential issue: R5 from gate to source/battery positive. Good. If SW1 open, gate pulled to source via R5 -> off. If SW1 closed, gate to GND -> on. Good.

Now look for component identity anomalies: R13/R14 footprints: 0603 not handsolder, while R9-R12 handsolder. Not issue. R13/R14 values 0. Good.

Could be anomaly in netlist: R6 is 2k from +3V3 to /TTL. Spec says R6 2k bias/pull network on A/B lines and DE/RE. Good. But if R6 is pull-up on A line to +3V3, and A line is TTL servo bus, when MAX3485 is in receive mode, A is input? In transmit mode, driver outputs. Pull-up may load. OK.

Could be missing connection of B line to servo bus? If serial servos use RS-485 differential? Spec says shared TTL serial bus, not differential. But component is MAX3485 RS-485. Maybe intended to use A/B differential to servos? Let's examine. Stack-chan serial servos RS304MD are TTL serial half-duplex (single wire). Some designs use MAX3485 to convert UART to TTL serial by using A as output/input and B as reference? But if only A connected to signal, B not connected to servo bus, it's like single-ended RS-485? MAX3485 A/B are differential; using one side as signal and other biased may work? Need see if anomaly: B line not connected to servo headers; spec says "shared single-wire TTL serial servo bus". It doesn't explicitly say B connected. It says R6,R7,R8,R15 bias/pull network on MAX3485 A/B differential lines. So B bias only. Could be intended.

But maybe serial servo bus should connect to both A and B? No, single wire cannot connect to differential pair. Some circuits use MAX3485 as level shifter: A to signal, B to bias. OK.

Need check if PWM and serial modes mutually exclusive. Netlist allows if R13/R14 populated and R3/R4 populated, then PWM GPIOs tied to TTL bus via 1k/0? But assembly selection. Not anomaly.

Need check if any passive value wrong: R2 5.1k with tolerance 0.1%. Could be intended? The spec says R1,R2 10k,5.1k. No tolerance. 0.1% is not wrong. R5 47k. Good.

Could be wrong footprint for D1: SS54 is SMA package? D1 footprint D_SMA correct. D2 PMEG3030EP is SOD-128? PMEG3030EP maybe SOD-128? Good.

Could be wrong part for D2: value PMEG3030EP, libsource D_Schottky, LCSC C255587. Good.

Could be wrong C1-C4: LCSC C15008. Need check C15008 maybe 100uF 16V 1206? OK.

Could be wrong URL? Not.

Need look at netlist: J2 (bottom connector?) footprint PinSocket, J1 PinHeader. Spec says top and bottom bus connectors identical nets. OK.

Potential issue: +5V net includes D1 cathode (K). If D1 is generic diode with pin1 K, pin2 A. Netlist has D1 pin1 K to +5V, pin2 A to J7. Good. But in SPICE D not modelled. OK.

Potential issue: D2 pin1 K to servo rail, pin2 A to +5V. Good.

Potential issue: Q1 P-MOS pin1 G, pin2 S, pin3 D. Netlist matches. If footprint SOT-23, IRLML6402 pinout: 1 G, 2 S, 3 D? Let's verify IRLML6402 SOT-23: pin1 G, pin2 S, pin3 D? Usually SOT-23 P-channel: 1=G, 2=S, 3=D? Yes. Good.

Potential issue: Q2 BC857 pinout: 1 B, 2 E, 3 C. Netlist matches. Good.

Potential issue: U1 MAX3485 pinout: 1 RO, 2 ~RE, 3 DE, 4 DI, 5 GND, 6 A, 7 B, 8 VCC. Netlist matches.

Potential issue: R1/R2/Q2: R1 from +3V3 to /TXD2, R2 from /TXD2 to Q2 B. Q2 E +3V3. If /TXD2 is driven by M5Stack, pull-up R1 to +3V3. When TXD2 low, current flows from +3V3 through Q2 E-B? Actually Q2 on: base low, collector high. But R1 pull-up to +3V3 on TXD2 may fight M5Stack driver. M5Stack GPIO 3.3V, R1 10k weak. OK. R2 5.1k base. Good.

Could there be an anomaly with R7 20k from Q2 C to GND. Spec says R7 in bias/pull network on DE/RE. Good.

Now, maybe check if any net names missing: There is no net for /TTL to J3? It goes via R14 to J8 pin3 and R13 to J3 pin3. Good.

Could there be a short_to_supply or ground: C3 orientation? C3 pin2 GND, pin1 servo rail; others pin1 GND pin2 rail. Since capacitor unpolarized, no issue. If polarized, orientation mismatch could be anomaly? But libsource C unpolarized. Spec says 100u bulk capacitance. If actual tantalum/electrolytic, polarity? But design files show unpolarized. Could be deliberate? Not enough.

Need consider known limitations: spec says SG90 can smoke, inrush, torque damage, etc. Not anomalies.

Maybe hidden anomaly: D1 value SS54 but schematic note "forward voltage > 0.6V"? Wait spec: D1 SS54 (5A Schottky) series diode between J7 and +5V rail. Schematic note nearby: "forward voltage > 0.6V". SS54 typical Vf maybe 0.5V at 5A? Annotation says >0.6V? Not in netlist. Not anomaly.

Could be wrong component: D1 libsource generic "D" not Schottky. But value says SS54. If assembly BOM, SS54. Not electrical.

Could be wrong value: R6 spec 2k, netlist 2k. R7 20k. R8 2.2k. R15 2.2k. Good.

Could be wrong tolerance: R2 0.1% maybe if 5.1k resistor tolerance? Not harmful. But maybe 0.1% is unusual for base resistor, but not deviation from intended? Spec silent. Could be sourcing mistake? But no impact.

Could be missing component: Spec lists R13,R14 jumpers. Present. R9-R12 present. SW1 optional present. Q2 present. All present.

Could be extra component: None.

Could be footprint mismatch: R3/R4/R5/R9-R12 use handsolder pads, others normal. Not issue. J1/J2 SMD connectors. OK.

Could be bridged nets: Need examine if any net unexpectedly merges. /PWM1 net includes R9.1, R10.1, R3.2. If both R9 and R10 populated, PWM1 tied to both bus pins 19 and 21. But intended select one; assembly can populate wrong. Netlist alone doesn't indicate populated. All components exist. Not anomaly.

/TTL includes R14.1, R6.2, U1.6. J8 pin3 includes R13.1, R14.2, R4.1. If R13/R14 populated, merges J3/J8 and TTL. Intended serial mode.

Net-(J5-Pin_1) includes Q1 S and R5.2. Good.

Net-(Q1-G) includes R5.1 and SW1.2. Good.

GND includes SW1.3. Good.

Potential issue: R5 is 47k from gate to source. Spec says pulls Q1's gate low via R5, 47k. Actually R5 from gate to battery positive, not low. But it's pull-up to source. OK.

Potential issue: Q1 gate connected to source via R5; if battery not connected, source floating. SW1 to GND. If switch closed with no battery, gate tied to GND, source floating; maybe body diode? Not issue.

Could be wrong polarity of D1? Let's re-evaluate: D1 pin1 K to +5V, pin2 A to J7. For diode symbol pin1 cathode, pin2 anode. Current from anode to cathode: J7 -> D1 -> +5V. Good. Blocks reverse +5V -> J7. If reversed, anomaly. It is correct.

D2: pin2 A to +5V, pin1 K to servo rail. Current +5V -> D2 -> servo rail. Good.

Could be wrong polarity of Q1? P-FET source should be higher potential (battery) and drain to load. Netlist source to J5 pin1, drain to /BAT. Good. If swapped, body diode would always conduct? But correct.

Could be wrong Q2 polarity? PNP emitter to +3V3, collector to DE/RE, base to TXD2. Good. If NPN, wrong. Value BC857 PNP. Good.

Here R6 pull-up A to +3V3, R8 pull-up B to +3V3 and R15 pull-down B to GND (voltage divider B = 1.65V? Actually R8 2.2k to +3V3, R15 2.2k to GND => B idle 1.65V). A pull-up 2k. But wait spec: "R6, R7, R8, R15 | 2k, 20k, 2.2k, 2.2k | Bias/pull network on the MAX3485 A/B differential lines and DE/RE enable line." It doesn't state which resistor on which line. Netlist: R6 on A, R8/R15 on B, R7 on DE/RE. Good.

Potential anomaly: R14 is 0 from /TTL to J8 pin3. R13 is 0 from J8 pin3 to J3 pin3. If R13/R14 populated, both servo signals tied to /TTL. Good. But if only R13 populated, J3 and J8 tied together but not to U1; if only R14, J8 tied to U1. Assembly notes. Not issue.

Could be missing series resistor between U1 A and TTL bus? R14 0, but U1 A can drive. OK.

Now, maybe compare netlist to spec component table: J1/J2 labelled M-BUS, Conn_02x15. Present. J3,J8 Conn_01x03. Present. J5 Conn_01x02 labelled BAT. Present. J6 Conn_01x04. Present. J7 Conn_01x02 labelled 5V_POWER. Present. D1 SS54. D2 PMEG3030EP. C1-C4 100u. C5 0.1u. Q1 IRLML6402. SW1 SPDT. Q2 BC857. U1 MAX3485. R1,R2. R6,R7,R8,R15. R3,R4. R9-R12. R13,R14. All present.

Need perhaps check if R10/R11/R12 values? All 0. Good.

Could be wrong value: R11/R12 footprints? No.
